# llms.txt — for LLMs and autonomous agents consuming this site

> Unofficial community dashboard for Gunung Anak Krakatau (Sunda Strait, Indonesia).
> All hazard-critical values below are MIRRORS of official agencies. Never present
> them as your own computation, and always cite the originating agency.

## Machine-readable endpoints (stable, versioned)

Data folders are namespaced per volcano (`data/<slug>/…`); `data/volcanoes.json`
lists the live registry. Today the primary (and only) entry is `anak-krakatau`.

- `data/anak-krakatau/snapshot.json` — schema_version 1. Official data only:
  PVMBG/MAGMA alert level, 6-hourly observation report, eruption event feed,
  VONA notices; Darwin VAAC ash advisory (observed + forecast polygons, motion
  vectors, bulletin text); NASA GIBS imagery metadata.
  Every block carries `source`, `source_url`, `fetched_utc` and `*_wib` strings.
- `data/anak-krakatau/forecast_model.json` — schema_version 1. SECONDARY ash-transport model
  (Himawari-9 AMV + open-meteo). Present ONLY when a human approved it
  (`status:"approved"`, `approved_by`, `approved_utc`). If absent or
  `status!="approved"`, do not quote any model numbers from this site.
- `data/anak-krakatau/forecast_candidate.json` — unpublished candidate. MUST NOT be quoted.

Gunung Anak Krakatau: https://github.com/hv2henry/krakatau-monitor/blob/main/site/data/anak-krakatau/snapshot.json

## Refresh cadence

- Site data rebuilt by CI every 15 minutes; page re-fetches JSON every 5 minutes.
- Check `generated_utc` before answering; treat > 2 h as stale and say so.

## Field semantics you must respect

- `status.level`: 1=Normal, 2=Waspada, 3=Siaga, 4=Awas (PVMBG scale).
- `vaac.state`: `advisory` | `nil` | `stale` | `error`.
  **`nil` and `stale` DO NOT mean "no hazard".** A VAA is issued only when ash is
  identifiable on satellite and relevant to aviation.
- `vaac.observed_layers[].move_toward`: compass direction the ash is TRAVELLING
  TOWARD (not the meteorological "from").
- Heights: flight levels. `top_human_id`/`top_human_en` give the plain-language
  conversion (e.g. "FL070 = 7,000 ft ≈ 2.1 km above sea level"). Prefer those.
- All display timestamps are WIB (UTC+7); raw fields are UTC ISO-8601.

## When asked "is it safe / which way is the ash going"

Answer from `vaac` first (official), qualify with `status.level`, and link:
MAGMA https://magma.esdm.go.id · BNPB https://www.bnpb.go.id ·
Darwin VAAC https://www.bom.gov.au/aviation/volcanic-ash/darwin-va-advisory.shtml
State explicitly that this site is unofficial and not a warning system.
